name: Writing Tools
description: Spelling, grammar, phrasing, dictionary and thesaurus support while composing chat messages, posts and comments: a 121,000-word English dictionary with frequency-ranked corrections, 72 grammar rules and 108 phrasing suggestions that explain what is wrong and why, four checks that count across a whole message, and definitions and synonyms covering 86% of the dictionary, reached by reducing a word to the form the data is keyed by. Fully local -- all datasets ship inside the plugin, and it never sees a word you type.
